shoe-size-converter.quickAnswer: Choose the sizing system you know (UK, US men, US women, EU or Japanese), pick your size, and the tool shows the matching size in every other system at once — plus the full chart with your row highlighted.
keyFacts: The UK system starts near 3 for adults and increases in half sizes; US men is roughly UK + 0.5.
US women sizes run about 1.5 larger than US men for the same foot.
EU sizes are based on the Paris point (2/3 cm per size) and run higher numerically.
Japanese sizes are the simplest: they equal foot length in centimetres (e.g. 26.5 = 26.5 cm).
Sizes vary between brands, so always check the maker size chart for an exact fit.
howTo: Select the sizing system your size is written in.
Choose your size from the size dropdown.
Read the equivalent sizes in all other systems in the results.
Scroll the chart to compare neighbouring sizes.
When buying online, confirm against the brand own size chart.
shoe-size-converter.formula:
The systems are related by lookup tables, not a single formula.
Approximate relations: US men ≈ UK + 0.5, US women ≈ UK + 1.5, EU ≈ UK + 33, JP (cm) ≈ foot length
shoe-size-converter.workedExample:
Your size is EU 42. Find the UK equivalent.
Step 1: Select system "EU" and size "42".
Step 2: The chart row for EU 42 reads: UK 8, US men 8.5, US women 10, JP 26.5.
Answer: EU 42 = UK 8 = US men 8.5 = US women 10 = JP 26.5 cm.

faqs.q: What is EU 42 in UK size?
faqs.a: EU 42 corresponds to UK 8, which is US men 8.5 and US women 10.

faqs.q: How do US men and US women sizes differ?
faqs.a: For the same foot, US women is about 1.5 sizes larger than US men. Example: US men 8.5 = US women 10.

faqs.q: What does Japanese shoe size mean?
faqs.a: Japanese sizes equal the foot length in centimetres. JP 26.5 means the shoe fits a 26.5 cm foot — the most direct system of all.

faqs.q: Why do sizes differ between brands?
faqs.a: Each brand uses its own last (foot mould) and may round differently, so a UK 8 in one brand can fit like a UK 7.5 in another. Always check the brand chart.

faqs.q: How do I measure my foot for the right size?
faqs.a: Stand on paper, mark heel and longest toe, and measure the distance in cm. Compare with the JP column of the chart.

faqs.q: Is my size data stored anywhere?
faqs.a: No. The conversion runs entirely in your browser; nothing is sent or stored.
